inline_image_prefetcher_increment.ported_behavior: Extracts URLs via LinkUrlExtraction.extractAllUrls; fans work out in parallel per URL across an image-dimension-probe path (gated by allowImageProbes, skip-if-already-cached against InlineImageDimensionsStore) and a link-preview-card path (always invoked, self-gates internally); on a .Loaded card result, persists the resolved hero-image aspect ratio under the ORIGINAL PAGE URL (not the probe URL); dataStore is constructor-injected (not threaded per-call), matching the source's init signature exactly.
disclosed_deviations: dataStore narrowed to the already-established LinkPreviewPersisting role (2 methods) rather than the source's full PersistenceStoreProtocol, matching the narrow-adapter doctrine used throughout this WP.

Each extracted URL string is parsed to a java.net.URI; a URISyntaxException silently skips that one URL -- an explicitly disclosed hardening not present in the source's typed [URL] return, which cannot contain an unparseable entry.

An ordinary exception escaping a per-URL launch is treated as a genuine contract violation of one of the two injected collaborator roles (both documented as non-throwing by contract), not an expected outcome requiring its own recovery path.
